items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: We'd come back sometime after the Thomas East would break up with Gil going in. Played just with the bars, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, we were just talking to Lil Armstrong about that. That's right.

Said he played over there. I used to play over there with Brownlee too at Thomas East, right out of Harvey. Every Saturday night. You talk about a hot spot. That was it. And we used to play at the Red Top Inn in Gretchen. That was a bar with Brownlee. We'd come back sometime after the Thomas East would break up with Gil going in. Played just with the bars, you know. This Norman Brownlee was a regular guy.
Do you know him, Dan? Yeah, I know him. I went to Pensacola.
